crossRefs.note: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.
He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
“Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.
Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with them…
